arxiv-2101-09715.title: 2020 Conference on Self-Organising Systems at Christian-Albrechts University in Kiel Combining SimTrust and Weighted Simple Exponential Smoothing
arxiv-2101-09715.creator: Tobias Michel Latta
arxiv-2101-09715.description: Abstract In the domain of Autonomic and Organic Computing, the entities of a distributed system are variable as well as the efficiency and the intention of their work. Therefore, a scalable mechanism to incentivise/sanction entities which contribute towards/against the system goal is needed. Trust is a suited metric to find benevolent entities.

arxiv-2102-08922.title: Jet-accretion system in the nearby mJy Radio Galaxies
arxiv-2102-08922.creator: Paola Grandi, Eleonora Torresi, Duccio Macconi, Bia Boccardi, Alessandro Capetti
arxiv-2102-08922.description: Abstract It is generally thought that FRII Radio Galaxies host thin optically thick disks, while FRIs are powered by Advected Dominated Accretion Flows. The sources with an efficient engine are optically classified as High Excitation Radio Galaxies (HERGs) and those with an inefficient motor as Low Excitation Radio Galaxies (LERGs).

arxiv-2401-11355.title: Measurement of the double-differential inclusive jet cross section in proton-proton collisions at s = 5.02 ​ \TeV \sqrt{s}=5.02\TeV
arxiv-2401-11355.description: Abstract The inclusive jet cross section is measured as a function of jet transverse momentum \pt and rapidity y y . The measurement is performed using proton-proton collision data at s = 5.02 ​ \TeV \sqrt{s}=5.02\TeV , recorded by the CMS experiment at the LHC, corresponding to an integrated luminosity of 27.4 \pbinv .

arxiv-2404-11556.title: Hierarchical storage management in user space for neuroimaging applications
arxiv-2404-11556.creator: Valérie Hayot-Sasson, Tristan Glatard
arxiv-2404-11556.description: Abstract Neuroimaging open-data initiatives have led to increased availability of large scientific datasets. While these datasets are shifting the processing bottleneck from compute-intensive to data-intensive, current standardized analysis tools have yet to adopt strategies that mitigate the costs associated with large data transfers. A major challenge in adapting neuroimaging applications for data-intensive processing is that they must be entirely rewritten.

arxiv-2411-10294.title: Static network structure cannot stabilize cooperation among Large Language Model agents
arxiv-2411-10294.creator: Jin Han, Balaraju Battu, Ivan Romić, Talal Rahwan, Petter Holme
arxiv-2411-10294.description: Abstract Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to model human social behavior, with recent research exploring their ability to simulate social dynamics. Here, we test whether LLMs mirror human behavior in social dilemmas, where individual and collective interests conflict. Humans generally cooperate more than expected in laboratory settings, showing less cooperation in well-mixed populations but more in fixed networks.

arxiv-2412-14257.title: Quantum entropy and QCD factorization for low- Q 2 Q^{2} ν \nu DIS Contribution to the 25th International Workshop on Neutrinos from Accelerators
arxiv-2412-14257.creator: Henry Bloss ∗§, Brandon Kriesten †, T. J. Hobbs ‡
arxiv-2412-14257.description: Abstract Deeply inelastic scattering (DIS) is an essential process for exploring the structure of visible matter and testing the standard model. At the same time, the theoretical interpretation of DIS measurements depends on QCD factorization theorems whose validity deteriorates at the lower values of Q 2 Q^{2} and W 2 W^{2} typical of neutrino DIS in accelerator-based oscillation searches.

arxiv-2505-08738.title: Leptoquark searches at ATLAS and CMS
arxiv-2505-08738.creator: I. Neutelings on behalf of the ATLAS and CMS Collaborations
arxiv-2505-08738.description: Abstract An overview of searches for leptoquarks in proton-proton collisions at ATLAS and CMS are presented, with a focus on results from the Run-2 dataset collected between 2016 and 2018 at s = 13 TeV \sqrt{s}=$13\text{\,}\mathrm{T}\mathrm{e}\mathrm{V}$ , and corresponding to an integrated luminosity of 137– 140 fb − 1 140\text{\,}\mathrm{f}\mathrm{b}^{-1} . In particular, recent results are highlighted.

arxiv-2505-17464.title: Hydra: Structured Cross-Source Enhanced Large Language Model Reasoning
arxiv-2505-17464.creator: Xingyu Tan, Xiaoyang Wang, Qing Liu, Xiwei Xu, Xin Yuan, Liming Zhu, Wenjie Zhang
arxiv-2505-17464.description: Abstract Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) enhances large language models (LLMs) by incorporating external knowledge. Current hybrid RAG system retrieves evidence from both knowledge graphs (KGs) and text documents to support LLM reasoning. However, it faces challenges like handling multi-hop reasoning, multi-entity questions, multi-source verification, and effective graph utilization.

arxiv-2509-19422.title: Spectral Uniformity of Little Red Dots: A Natural Outcome of Coevolving Seed Black Holes and Nascent Starbursts
arxiv-2509-19422.creator: Kohei Inayoshi, Kohta Murase, Kazumi Kashiyama
arxiv-2509-19422.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Kohei Inayoshi, Kohta Murase, Kazumi Kashiyama. The birth of seeds of massive black holes (BHs) and nascent galaxies at cosmic dawn takes place in dense gaseous environments, which play a crucial role in shaping their coevolution and radiation spectra. We investigate gas accretion during the assembly of massive halos with M h ≳ 10 10 − 11 ​ M ⊙ M_{\rm h}\gtrsim 10^{10-11}~M_{\odot} at redshifts z ≃ 4 − 10 z\simeq 4-10 , driving both rapid BH feeding and concurrent nuclear starbursts.

arxiv-2512-12081.title: Congestion Reduction in EV Charger Placement Using Traffic Equilibrium Models Thanks: † \dagger : Contributed equally. ‡ \ddagger : Corresponding author. Yasin Sonmez, Can Kizilkale and Murat Arcak are with the Department of Electrical Engineering and Computer Sciences at the University of Californi
arxiv-2512-12081.creator: Semih Kara ,\quad Yasin Sonmez ,\quad Can KizilkaleAlex Kurzhanskiy,Nuno C. Martins,Murat Arcak
arxiv-2512-12081.description: Abstract Growing EV adoption can worsen traffic conditions if chargers are sited without regard to their impact on congestion. We study how to strategically place EV chargers to reduce congestion using two equilibrium models: one based on congestion games and one based on an atomic queueing simulation. We apply both models within a scalable greedy station-placement algorithm.

pmc-10596147.title: Healthcare utilization during the COVID-19 pandemic: changes, potential causes. A Swiss cohort study
pmc-10596147.creator: E Harju, A Speierer, K T Jungo, S Levati, S Baggio, M A Puhan, N Probst-Hensch, G Michel, N Rodondi, P Chocano-Bedoya
pmc-10596147.description: BackgroundThe COVID-19 pandemic led to a decrease in the provision and use of healthcare. Few studies reported reasons for these changes. We aimed to (i) describe the frequency of changes in healthcare utilization in those requiring ongoing treatment, and possible reasons thereof, and (ii) assess characteristics associated with change, during the second wave of the pandemic.

pmc-10749974.title: The undiscovered biosynthetic potential of the Greenland Ice Sheet microbiome
pmc-10749974.creator: Ate H. Jaarsma, Athanasios Zervas, Katie Sipes, Francisco Campuzano Jiménez, Andrea Claire Smith, Liessel Victoria Svendsen, Mariane S. Thøgersen, Peter Stougaard, Liane G. Benning, Martyn Tranter, Alexandre M. Anesio
pmc-10749974.description: The Greenland Ice Sheet is a biome which is mainly microbially driven. Several different niches can be found within the glacial biome for those microbes able to withstand the harsh conditions, e.g., low temperatures, low nutrient conditions, high UV radiation in summer, and contrasting long and dark winters.

pmc-11642397.title: Impact of Oxidative Stress on Sperm Quality in Oligozoospermia and Normozoospermia Males Without Obvious Causes of Infertility

pmc-11642397.description: Background: Male factors contribute to approximately 50% of infertile couples. However, obvious causes remain unknown in many cases. This observational study aimed to investigate the associations of clinical and lifestyle parameters with sperm parameters. Methods: This study enrolled 41 men in infertile couples without obvious causes for male infertility from July 2023 to April 2024.

pmc-11668542.title: Intraoperative Hemodynamic Instability in a Patient With Ebstein's Anomaly Complicated With Eisenmenger Syndrome
pmc-11668542.creator: Leonardo A. Marquez Roa, Jorge Araujo-Duran, Richard Hofstra, Jibran Ikram, Sabry Ayad
pmc-11668542.description: Ebstein's anomaly is a rare congenital displacement of the tricuspid valve resulting in atrialization of the right ventricle. About half of the patients with Ebstein's anomaly also have atrial septal defects, which may lead to chronic shunting and development of Eisenmenger syndrome.

pmc-12644183.title: Biphasic Plate – kontrollierte Instabilität in der Frakturheilung
pmc-12644183.creator: Christoph Sommer, Moritz Lodde, Ladina Hofmann-Fliri, Michael J Raschke
pmc-12644183.description: Die knöcherne Konsolidierung nach einer Fraktur hängt von verschiedenen Faktoren ab. Unter optimalen Bedingungen erfolgt sie innerhalb von wenigen Wochen. Grundvoraussetzung für die Frakturheilung ist die Wiederherstellung der adäquaten biomechanischen Stabilität mit möglichst idealer interfragmentärer Bewegung. Die distale Femurfraktur stellt, insbesondere bei ausgeprägtem Weichteilschaden, mehrfragmentärer Fraktursituation und Gelenkbeteiligung eine besondere Herausforderung dar.

pmc-12667647.title: Glutamate dehydrogenase 2 is required for virulence by facilitating fungal growth in the host hemocoel
pmc-12667647.creator: Yuzhen Lu, Denghui Wu, Jiawei Hu, Guojun Peng, Jielai Zhong, Yan Liu, Jing Li, Qiang Gao, Xiao-Qiang Yu
pmc-12667647.description: Metarhizium robertsii, a fungal pathogen employed in pest biocontrol, can alkalize the surrounding environment, although the biological implications remain unclear. Here, we found that M. robertsii glutamate dehydrogenase 2 (MrGDH2) was responsible for alkalization during fungal growth on insect wings or media containing cuticle powder.
